routing: gpt_image_2 at server defaults (1k, quality low, 0.5 cr) for every quadrant atlas, the magenta-key card sheet and both 21:9 sky sources; flux_2 pro (1.0 cr) for the hero frames in ../heroes; no maquettes (the ../sheets ortho model sheets supersede them).
convention: Every atlas is a 2x2 quadrant sheet at 1024x1024: quadrant UV rects are TL (0,0.5)-(0.5,1), TR (0.5,0.5)-(1,1), BL (0,0)-(0.5,0.5), BR (0.5,0)-(1,0.5) in GL (bottom-origin) V; thin gutter lines must be inset (0.004) so bilinear sampling never bleeds a neighbour.
division_of_labour: Orchestrator generates and eyeballs every image and records the verdict here; the implementer converts, crops, posterises, UV-maps and integrates, and may NOT generate new images - it reports what is missing and why.

sky-day-gptimage2.png.prompt: Create exactly one seamless panoramic SKY TEXTURE, an extreme horizontal panorama for a 360 degree game sky, meant to be wrapped on a sphere. No panels, borders or lettering. DREAM ISLAND, tropical noon, one consistent lighting state across the whole width: a hard saturated cobalt-to-azure blue sky with small scattered puffy white cumulus clouds in the naive early-2000s screensaver style, clouds flat-bottomed and evenly spread, no sun disc, no moon, no stars, no lens flare, no dark storm clouds. Sky-band brightness variation across the whole width must be less than 2:1; no abrupt warmth changes anywhere. The bottom quarter is a continuous calm sea horizon in deep cobalt with a thin pale haze line and a few tiny distant sea-stack silhouettes, no islands, no buildings. Left and right edges must match continuously in colour and cloud height so the image tiles horizontally. Whole image is one long painting with a low horizon. Hand-painted, slightly soft.
sky-day-gptimage2.png.review: KEEP as the day source. Even cloud field, no sun disc, low horizon with sea-stack silhouettes. Native 1344x576 - resample to 4096x1024 (Lanczos) and run scripts/visual/tideline-v4/sky-profile.py (4096x1024, warm_step<=.05, ratio<=2) before acceptance; the edge blend in the shader covers any residual seam.

sky-night-gptimage2.png.review: KEEP as the night source. Same resample + sky-profile gate as the day sky. Stars will soften at 3x upscale - acceptable for the register; revisit only on eyeball.
